name: Centennial Hall in Wrocław
description: Centennial Hall in Wrocław, Poland, is a huge concrete arena designed by Max Berg and completed in 1913. Its clover-shaped plan wraps around a vast round auditorium seating about 6,000 people, beneath a 23-metre dome crowned with a steel-and-glass lantern. It was a pioneering feat of reinforced concrete, and it still hosts concerts, sports events and summits.
